subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] OpenClaw WebChat: Conversation Management & Multi-AI Collaboration

question: Should this remain the canonical broad WebChat conversation-management and multi-AI collaboration tracker, and which remaining parts should OpenClaw core own versus plugins or narrower follow-up issues?
rationale: Current main implements a useful session-management subset, while the remaining request defines product/API boundaries across WebChat UI, Gateway session metadata, project organization, and multi-agent orchestration.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker and require narrower maintainer-designed milestones for project/topic organization, protocol/storage support, and multi-model collaboration.

options.title: Narrow Core Scope
options.body: Limit OpenClaw core to session/project organization and route committee, meeting, and consensus workflows to plugin or RFC work unless a missing core API is proven.

options.title: Transfer Then Close
options.body: Close this umbrella only after all remaining requirements are moved to clearly canonical narrower issues for projects, topic trees, and multi-agent collaboration.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker and require narrower maintainer-designed milestones for project/topic organization, protocol/storage support, and multi-model collaboration.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the canonical-tracker signal and authored the recent session-management foundation most adjacent to the product decision.
